question.prompt:
There are \(20\) cities in the County of Newton. Their populations are shown in the bar chart below. The average population of all the cities is indicated by the horizontal dashed line. Which of the following is closest to the total population of all \(20\) cities?

[Figure 1](figures/2020_AMC_8_Q14_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
The dashed line gives the average, so we do not need to add the twenty individual bars. Multiply the average population by \(20\) to get the total.

The line lies between \(4500\) and \(5000\), which puts the total between

\[
20\cdot4500=90{,}000
\quad\text{and}\quad
20\cdot5000=100{,}000.
\]

Among the choices, \(\boxed{95{,}000}\) is closest, choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\). Throughout that interval it is closer than either neighboring choice, \(85{,}000\) or \(105{,}000\), so a more precise graph reading is unnecessary.
solutions.title: Multiply the plotted mean by the number of cities
